queries.query: How many days can I return footwear?

hits.document_text: Footwear can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The product should be unworn, with the original box, tags, and accessories intact.
Apparel items can be returned within 7 days of delivery when unused, unwashed, and accompanied by original tags and packaging.
Beauty products may be returned within 7 days only when unopened, unused, and sealed. Opened personal-care products are not eligible for return.

queries.query: How long does a COD refund take?

hits.document_text: For an approved prepaid return, the refund is initiated after quality checks and is normally reflected within 5 to 7 business days, depending on the bank.
For an approved cash-on-delivery return, the refund is initiated after quality checks and normally reaches the customer's bank account within 7 business days.
Eligible electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery for defects or damage. Serial numbers and original accessories must match the order.

queries.query: Can I return an electronics item?

hits.document_text: Eligible electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery for defects or damage. Serial numbers and original accessories must match the order.
Products marked non-returnable on the product page cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Hygiene and personalized items may have additional exclusions.
A replacement may be offered for an eligible damaged, defective, or incorrect item when stock is available. The request must be raised within the applicable return window.
Reverse pickup is available for eligible pin codes and products. The item must be packed securely and meet the relevant return-condition requirements.
Products marked non-returnable on the product page cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Hygiene and personalized items may have additional exclusions.

The estimated delivery date shown at checkout is the delivery SLA for an order. Delays can occur because of weather, network disruption, or address issues.
Books may be returned within 7 days of delivery when they are undamaged and have no writing, highlighting, or missing pages.
